# China Festivals

> A decision guide to China's festivals, with 2026 dates, a festival finder, best cities, foods, and insider tips for travellers.

China Festivals helps travellers decide which of China's 22 festivals to experience, when to go, and where. It covers lunar festivals (Spring Festival, Mid-Autumn), ethnic festivals (Water Splashing, Torch), modern holidays (Harbin Ice, National Day), and seasonal events (cherry blossoms, Luoyang peonies).

## Key sections

- Festival Finder (choose by traveller type): https://www.china-festivals.com/#finder
- China festival calendar 2026: https://www.china-festivals.com/#calendar
- All 22 Chinese festivals, explained: https://www.china-festivals.com/#festivals
- Where to experience each festival: https://www.china-festivals.com/#cities
- Travel tips (what to pack, eat, stay, get around): https://www.china-festivals.com/#tips
- Visa: the short version: https://www.china-festivals.com/#visa
- FAQ: https://www.china-festivals.com/#faq

## Key facts

- Chinese New Year 2026 falls on February 17, 2026.
- Mid-Autumn Festival 2026 falls on September 25, 2026.
- China offers visa-free entry to citizens of 76 countries, plus a 240-hour transit-free policy for 55 countries.
- Lunar festivals shift dates every year; this guide is refreshed each January.
